deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'set +e; echo "[start] PID=$$ PORT=$PORT WORKER_ID=${WORKER_ID:-unset} PYTHONUNBUFFERED=${PYTHONUNBUFFERED:-0}"; echo "[start] DATABASE_URL set: $([ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ] && echo yes || echo no)"; echo "[start] running alembic upgrade head (max 15s)"; timeout 15 alembic upgrade head 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 124 ]; then echo "[start] alembic returned rc=$rc, continuing"; elif [ $rc -eq 124 ]; then echo "[start] alembic timed out, continuing"; else echo "[start] alembic ok"; fi; echo "[start] starting uvicorn on port $PORT"; exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --log-level info --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips="*"'
